contexts: mixed veterinary practice with dairy clients
advice given at routine visits and in leaflets
vet time of one half-day a week each for two vets
reading: Adoption fails where advice is generic, housing and labour are short, and nobody follows up (claims c1 and c3). A facilitated plan agreed by the herd's own vet has randomised support (claim c2), so the practice's question is how to deliver and sustain it with the vet time it has. Farmer report cannot measure success (claim c4).
